title: MORI Common Defect
description: A frequently-seen audit defect, linked to a MORI evidence-gap signal (mori_signal). Bilingual (KO/EN).

evidence_gap_ko.description: Which missing evidence makes this a defect (KO)

mori_signal.description: Dashboard 'today's work queue' (evidence-gaps) tile key. e.g. vuln_pending / unmapped_assets / untriaged_alerts / exceptions_expiring / overdue / control_pending. Empty string if none.
